customer_acme: Hey team — noticed our trial credits dropped from 750 -> 0 overnight. We didn't deploy anything. Billing page shows lots of small /rerank calls around 02:00 UTC. Any idea?

sarah_support: Sorry to hear that, we can investigate. Can you share the workspace id or the API key suffix? Also did you have any scheduled jobs running? :slightly_frowning_face:

customer_acme: Workspace: acme-inc, key suffix: ...-xz9. We have a nightly candidate-ranking job that runs at 01:50 UTC, but it normally hits our internal service which calls Redwood's `/v1/rerank`. It's supposed to be limited to 200 items.

alyssa_support: Thanks — I'm pulling logs now. Billing-bot shows ~28k small rerank token ops between 01:47 and 02:10. That aligns with your window. Was there any retry storm configured on your side?

customer_acme: No retries beyond 3 per item. We're seeing the job got stuck and re-enqueued by our scheduler once it timed out. Not sure why it exploded like that.

mike_infra: Looking at our ingestion traces for your workspace: we see a flurry of requests, but interestingly many of them returned `401 Unauthorized` for ~4m then started succeeding. Example from our edge logs:
```
[02:01:12] GET /v1/rerank 401 key_suffix=...-xz9
[02:01:13] GET /v1/rerank 401 key_suffix=...-xz9
[02:02:05] GET /v1/rerank 200 key_suffix=...-xz9 exec_time=23ms
[02:02:06] POST /events worker=ranker-4 requeue=true
```

jordan_engineer: That `requeue=true` looks suspicious — is your worker reenqueueing failed batches? On our side, we don't auto-retry unless customers use `retry` header. Also I see many requests with identical `idempotency_key` missing. If your scheduler re-enqueued without idempotency, each requeued item would rerun the rerank call.

customer_acme: We do set `idempotency_key` for bulk ingest, but the ranking pipeline is a separate process and we didn't add idempotency for `/rerank`. The scheduler will mark tasks as failed and requeue them.

sarah_support: Okay two things to investigate: 1) why were you seeing `401` for ~4m (could be a transient auth rotation or key mistype), 2) dedupe/retry semantics for your pipeline. We can follow up with ops to confirm token rotation at 02:00.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: auth-service rotated service tokens at 01:59:51 UTC (sha: f3a1c) — triggered by scheduled rotation.

mike_infra: Confirmed. There was a scheduled KMS-backed token rotation at 01:59:51. A subset of outbound connections briefly failed while apps picked up new creds. Those 401s line up. If your scheduler immediately requeues on failure, it would replay many tasks against the new token window.

jordan_engineer: For mitigation: add idempotency to the `/rerank` calls (we accept `Idempotency-Key` header). Also add exponential backoff before requeueing to avoid tight retry storms across rotation windows. Quick patch we recommend on your side:
```
if (resp.status === 401 || resp.status >= 500) {
  await sleep(backoff());
  if (retry_count < 5) requeue(); else escalate();
}
```

alyssa_support: We've flagged the workspace for a manual credit review. Please confirm the exact time window you'd like us to refund. We normally refund obvious rotation-related storms within 48h if requested. :white_check_mark:

customer_acme: Appreciate that. Please refund tokens consumed between 01:58:00 and 02:10:00 UTC. We'll push a fix to add `Idempotency-Key` and small delay before re-enqueue.

sarah_support: Filed refund request with billing team and set priority P2. @billing-bot can you capture the refund ticket?

billing-bot: Ticket created: BL-4821 — Refund request for workspace acme-inc, window 1968004680-1968005400 (pending verification). Agent: @michelle_billing. ETA 24-48h.

mike_infra: One more note — we recommend using our `batch_rerank` endpoint for nightly jobs if you have large fanout; it handles KV cache and prefix reuse and costs are lower. Also enables server-side dedupe if `Idempotency-Key` is provided.

customer_acme: Good to know — we'll evaluate that. Thanks everyone for the quick triage.

jordan_engineer: Logging follow-up items for internal runbook: 1) add a cross-check on scheduled token rotation times vs queued retries, 2) consider exposing rotation window alerts to customers.

alyssa_support: I'll close out after billing confirms refund. Leaving thread open until then. :pray:
